responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL web construction pass, which splits a pseudo register into independent webs of defs and uses to increase optimization effectiveness. Using DF use-def chains, match_dup relationships, read-write operands, and union-find sets over refs, it groups connected uses and defs, allocates new pseudos for disjoint webs, and rewrites RTL references accordingly. It is a classic pre-optimization register web splitting pass that prepares the RTL for better CSE, loop optimizations, and later register allocation behavior.
